method: Each section read in full by a machine-assisted reviewer against the packs and the ground catalogue as of this date; not a legal review.

sections.bearsOn: Establishes the objectives under Land Act s. 93.4 for the seven named landscape units or groups on Maps 1-7.
Requires all timber in the mapped OGMAs to be retained, so a block may not take any OGMA timber beyond section 3's minor-activity allowance.
sections.gapNote: The rules ask the order’s questions once the reviewer names the order; the OGMA screen still leaves harvest and road reach unknown.

sections.bearsOn: Allows minor forestry activity into an OGMA only while total disturbance stays within 10% of gross area for OGMAs under 50 ha, or the lesser of 5% or 40 ha for OGMAs of 50 ha or more.
sections.gapNote: The ceiling is tested on the gross OGMA area and disturbance the reviewer enters; the layer’s FEATURE_AREA_SQM could fill the area, and earlier disturbance is not mapped.

sections.bearsOn: Makes the Geographic Data Warehouse dataset, not the printed map, decide an OGMA's boundary.
sections.gapNote: The ogma screen already reads the warehouse layer (RMP_OGMA_LEGAL_CURRENT_SVW) this section makes decisive.

sections.bearsOn: Requires written notice to the Integrated Land Management Bureau's Land and Resource Team Leader when disturbance in an OGMA occurs under the allowance.
sections.gapNote: The rule asks for the notice; the reviewer names the successor office.

sections.bearsOn: Takes effect when notice is published in the Gazette.
Sets 12 months from the effective date as the period for FSP holders to amend their plans for these objectives (FRPA s. 8 mandatory amendment).
sections.gapNote: A document check that the FSP was amended within the period; the citation "8(2)(b)" matches no current FRPA paragraph.
